title: Graph snapshot restore reports an opaque type error for non-text catalog FTS keys
outcome: Classify malformed non-text work_catalog_fts keys consistently during graph snapshot restore without losing refusal or destination-state guarantees.
acceptance: Graph snapshot restore over a destination containing a NULL, integer or blob work_catalog_fts work_id reports InvalidWorkProjection with clear destination repair advice, or deliberately ignores that nonmatching malformed key; dry-run and real-load behavior have regression coverage and preserve the destination on refusal.
